capabilities: merge all notes in a folder into one file
trigger a merge from the folder context menu
extras: The README includes a preview image and detailed contribution guidelines, but little documentation of merge options or behavior beyond the right-click workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to combine the notes of a whole folder into one file when you need to export them.
summary: Folder merger that combines all notes in a folder into a single note for easier export.
